items.q: In the cardiac conduction infographic, which ion current is primarily responsible for the spontaneous phase 4 diastolic depolarization of sinoatrial nodal pacemaker cells?
o: Funny pacemaker current (If) carried through HCN channels
items.exp: The funny current (If), conducted by hyperpolarization-activated cyclic nucleotide-gated (HCN) channels, carries a slow inward mixed Na+/K+ flux activated during repolarization. This slowly depolarizes the sinoatrial node membrane from -60 mV toward threshold (-40 mV), initiating the next pacemaker action potential.
r: Incorrect. Fast inward sodium current is absent or negligible in SA nodal tissue.
Correct. The funny current (If) carries spontaneous phase 4 depolarization in pacemaker cells.
Incorrect. IK1 is absent in pacemaker cells, allowing spontaneous depolarization.
Incorrect. IKr repolarizes the membrane (phase 3), but does not drive phase 4 depolarization.
items.kp: Phase 4 pacemaker depolarization is driven by the inward funny current (If) via HCN channels.
